title: Fbinds
description: Create command keybinds with an intuitive animated GUI, rainbow HUD, and smooth blur effects. Supports modifiers (Shift/Ctrl), toggle mode, per-key cooldown, and auto-save. All client-side — works on any server!
body:
#FBinds v1
🔹 What does this mod do?
FBinds allows you to create, edit and manage custom keybinds (macros) for executing commands in Minecraft.
Instead of manually typing long commands, you can assign them to any key and execute them with a single press.

The mod adds:

Intuitive GUI menu for bind management

Modifier support (Shift/Ctrl + key)

Toggle mode — turn commands on/off with one key

Animated HUD showing active binds

Auto-save binds to JSON file

Export/Import binds (easily share with friends)

🔹 Why should you download it?
Save time — no need to remember complex commands

Convenience — intuitive GUI with animations and blur effect

Flexibility — modifiers, toggle mode, per-key cooldown

Aesthetics — stylish rainbow HUD like in popular clients

Compatibility — works on any server (client-side)

Lightweight — no performance impact, no server installation required

🔹 Important information before downloading
Minecraft version: 1.16.5 (Forge only)

For whom: players who want to speed up frequent command execution

Is it safe? Yes, the mod simply sends commands to chat — it doesn't automate gameplay or give PvP advantages

Does it work on servers? Yes, it's a client-side mod — servers don't need to install it

How to install: download the .jar file and place it in the mods folder

⚙️ Controls
J — open bind menu (can be changed in controls settings)

Shift/Ctrl + key — if modifiers are configured

Toggle mode — press key to enable, press again to disable
